Shortly after the first checkpoint completes, a second checkpoint is started.

results.snippet: When you are done with a linked working tree, remove it with git worktree remove. In its simplest form, git worktree add <path> automatically creates a new branch whose name is the final component of <path>, which is convenient if you plan to work on a new topic.

With git worktree add a new working tree is associated with the repository, along with additional metadata that differentiates that working tree from others in the same repository. The working tree, along with this metadata, is called a " worktree ".

L'arbre de travail, ainsi que ces métadonnées, est appelé un " worktree ".
